title: Reopening a paid work order copies its Bill To to the new one
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced and paid in full by customer B, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Reopen work order 1 onto a new work order.
  3. Open the new work order.
  4. Expand the Customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A, with status Paid.

Step 2:

  • A new work order is made from work order 1.

Step 3:

  • The new work order opens with customer A.

Step 4:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.
  • The Bill To field can be changed (the new work order is Open).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R7: “Splitting a work order or part sale, or reopening a paid work order onto a new one, copies its Bill To to the new one.”
